props.caption: Benghazi. Zelenskyy said Ukraine used seven domestically made naval drones in the operation.
Mercury. A public operations update confirmed BepiColombo’s capture into orbit.
Thailand will propose a 39 kg daily arsenic target at talks with China and Myanmar on 24 November.

lead.what: Zelenskyy said Ukraine used seven domestically made naval drones and sank a Russian corvette.

rest.what: India’s composite PMI edged up to 56.3 in November from 56.2 in October.

lead.what: A public operations update said BepiColombo had been captured into orbit around Mercury.

rest.what: Thailand will propose cutting estimated daily arsenic crossing the Sai River to about 39 kg from about 143 kg.

lead.what: The United Nations called for an independent investigation into drone attacks on two ships off Libya.
